brief:
Israel has revoked travel authorization for Brad Lander, a US Democratic congressional candidate, following his detention in the occupied West Bank, Al Jazeera English reported. The circumstances surrounding his detention were not specified in available reports.

Lander's travel ban marks a rare instance of Israel restricting movement for a prominent American political figure. The action follows his detention in the occupied territories.
dek: Israel has revoked travel authorisation for US Democratic congressional candidate Brad Lander after he was detained.
title: Israel bars US Democrat Brad Lander from travel after West Bank detention
